scope: Aircraft lateral feature ownership and termination/locality restoration design; not implementation or physical acceptance

findings.evidence: CortexAirAttack stores lateralPilot and lateralPilotFeatures in its job before disabling features. No durable actor feature receipt is published by this path.
findings.impact: Once the local brain/job is discarded, later owners cannot reconstruct exact restoration authority.

findings.evidence: airAttackOperation FSM OwnershipLost/Replaced/Superseded/Invalidated transitions can reach Finished without calling CortexAirAttack. Finished releases matching flight lease and clears its matching local brain; it does not execute lateral feature restoration. AirAttackOperationStep also cancels nonlocal/replaced brains before executor entry.
findings.impact: Normal executor cleanup cannot be assumed for every termination path. Old-owner callbacks must not mutate nonlocal actors.

findings.evidence: CortexLocality consumes restoreDisabled from WAIT_AIPass_Checkpoint; aircraft lateral snapshots are stored under lateralPilotFeatures in the aircraft job. No lateralPilot receipt consumer exists there.
findings.impact: Existing infantry restoration is not proof of aircraft feature handback. Verify checkpoint producer scope before reuse.

findings.evidence: Current cleanup requires retained original pilot, aboard/original group, matching flight lease and task/ownership guards.
findings.impact: Prevents restoration onto replacement/protected actors but can leave original actor features disabled after protected takeover or departure. Same-value external disable cannot be detected from checkAIFeature alone.

designRequirements: Use an actor-specific durable receipt containing schema version, issuer/controller, operation generation, flight token, original aircraft/group, exact actor, original feature states and applied values, plus explicit lifecycle status. No movement order or attack deadline is replayed.

Publish ownership before disabling features. Repeated admission must not overwrite a prior baseline or extend operation expiry. Read-modify-write must be owner-local with exact generation/token identity; stale cleanup cannot delete a successor receipt.

All terminal paths request release exactly once. Separate release of the attack operation from resolution of feature restoration; do not discard unresolved ownership solely because the brain finishes.

On locality gain, the actual actor owner inspects durable receipt, current task/external/player ownership and unchanged applied values. A group-local callback alone does not establish actor locality. Never remote a blanket enableAI to an inferred owner.

If a cooperating controller claims a feature, transfer/acknowledge feature authority explicitly. For uncooperative external same-value changes, retain a visible unresolved disposition rather than pretending value equality proves ownership.

Use existing lifecycle/discovery hooks or a bounded pending set, not a permanent per-actor/world scan. Define finite retry/terminal reporting and object deletion cleanup; expiry must not silently erase unresolved feature ownership.

Only restore originally enabled features still disabled by the matching receipt, with safe task permission. Pre-disabled features stay disabled. Repeated restoration is idempotent. Preserve newer actor reservations and native service tasks.

Replacement pilot, original pilot leaving aircraft/group, split aircraft/group/actor locality and newer flight lease all need explicit dispositions. New attacks must not snapshot already-leaked disabled state as the original baseline.
preparedAcceptanceRequirements: Normal lateral completion restores exact original features, including a pre-disabled TARGET control.
Player/Zeus/specialist/task takeover preserves new authority and resolves or explicitly reports deferred restoration after release.
Pilot replacement never changes replacement feature baseline; original pilot restoration follows actual actor locality.
Aircraft locality loss and actor/group split migration exercise every FSM terminal path and fresh-owner replay without flight reactivation.
Stale generation/repeated cancellation cannot clear a new receipt; deletion cleans bounded pending bookkeeping.
Measure pending-set cost and end-to-end frame time under many aircraft against 5% median/10% p95 budget.
disposition: OPEN_DESIGN_REQUIRED; no durable feature lease or deferred restorer implemented by this review; audits paused; all behavioural acceptance remains partial
